datasets.label: Drosophila melanogaster RNA-seq read set (SRR1509507, SRR14197369, SRR14404397)
datasets.description: Three paired-end Drosophila melanogaster RNA-seq read sets consumed through params.reads by the upstream STAR RS1 workflow.
datasets.storage_location: FONDA Kubernetes PVC rnaseq-pvc: /data/reads (mounted read-only at /input/data/reads during the workflow run)
datasets.access_statement: The public FASTQ files were resolved through the ENA Portal API and downloaded resumably from ENA. SHA-256 checksums of the exact tested inputs are included with this profile.

datasets.label: Drosophila melanogaster reference genome, annotation and cDNA (Ensembl BDGP6.32, release 106)
datasets.description: The genome FASTA, cDNA FASTA and GTF inputs used by the upstream workflow for STAR indexing and alignment, strandedness checking, and Cufflinks quantification.
datasets.storage_location: FONDA Kubernetes PVC rnaseq-pvc: /data/reference (mounted read-only at /input/data/reference during the workflow run)
datasets.access_statement: Assembly BDGP6.32 and Ensembl release 106 are pinned by the upstream STAR RS1 configuration. SHA-256 checksums of the exact tested inputs are included with this profile.
